title_options: the rally that broke the internet 🏸
he was NOT losing that point
hook_rationale: 1A: full-stretch diving save with the shuttle inches from the floor — motion + stakes in frame 1. 1B: net-cam POV jump smash straight at the lens — direct physical threat to the viewer, strongest pattern-interrupt.

1A.reason: High-stakes motion instantly readable; slightly generic sports-clip opening

1B.reason: Smash directly at the viewer breaks the fourth wall — rarest interrupt of the two; risk: shuttle may render oddly at high speed
